decision: The phone docs begin their own history: their first release is 0.1.0, and versions stay below 1.0 while the docs are still forming. The changelog and manifest inherited from the template they were made from are cleared, with a note saying whose history that was. Release-please reads its config and manifest.
why: The docs were made from text-as-data-template on 2026-11-04 and carried its history (1.0.0 to 1.2.0) as if their own; never released, release-please found no tag and proposed 1.0.0 - a claim of stability for docs days old and changing hourly.
rejected: Releasing 1.0.0 as proposed (promises what is not there); tagging 1.2.0 (it is the template's version, not the docs'); keeping the inherited changelog (it tells another repository's story as this one's).
